title: Read many sizable files (exercises tool-output trimming)
prompt: The directory src/ contains several JavaScript modules (mod01.js, mod02.js, …). Use list_dir to see them, then read EVERY .js file in src/ one at a time with read_file. After you have read all of them, reply with exactly the word COMPLETE followed by how many files you read, e.g. "COMPLETE 10". Do not stop early.
